notes.title: New Idle RPG Game Coming Soon to Steam!
notes.content:
Hello Folks,
I'm very pleased to announce that the page of our new game is finally available on Steam! 💀🏝️

I’m developing an Idle Creature Collecting RPG with Farming Features 🔥🍃🐾

🐊 Wishlist now! http://https://bit.ly/40Monster

[b][/b]

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/2310190/ss_6952da0bf45d3dedd65493d678b9d02fcd30ca34.1920x1080.jpg?t=1676161141[/img]


[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/2310190/ss_73523e8ab47dbd46975089c17c5fc6747b3c48d4.1920x1080.jpg?t=1676161141[/img]


[h3]Collect all creatures of Arcadius[/h3]

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/2310190/extras/Biomes_banner.png?t=1676161141[/img]


[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/2310190/extras/Collection.png?t=1676161141[/img]

[h3]
Defeat and capture Epic Creatures[/h3]
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/2310190/extras/Battle.png?t=1676161141[/img]

[h3]Farm to make your creatures stronger
[/h3]

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/2310190/extras/Farming.png?t=1676161141[/img]

[b][/b]


[h3]Features[/h3]
[list]
[*] ⚔️A Casual and Relaxing Idle RPG Game;
[*] 🏝️ Beautiful Graphics and Relaxing Ambience;
[*] 🦊 Manage your team to battle and capture ever more creatures;
[*] 🔨 Buy upgrades to get stronger and defeat all opponents;
[*] 📦 Choose your creatures according to different demands;
[*] ⛏️ Many items for you to discover and use;
[*] 🎒 Fully interactive Crafting/Inventory System;
[*] 🌟 Game content that continues to grow through expansions.
[/list]

notes.title: Update V1.1 - Bug fixes and Improvements!
notes.content:
Hello guys! 

After many bug reports from the community we are now releasing the version 1.1 of the game with many fixes and improvements. 

Hope you guys can enjoy the game now!
